description: My life is the thread connecting the story, but I am not the main subject.
The book is about the experiences, people, ideas, companies, technologies, failures, experiments, and choices that led us to build what we built around smallworld.
The imperfections, contradictions, uncertainty, mistakes, unfinished ideas, and changes of mind are part of the story.
